description: This Java class implements the service for creating, updating, and deleting 'Code' entities in the Fineract platform, with transaction management, security, caching, and data integrity handling.

classes.name: CodeWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of service for managing 'Code' entities with create, update, delete operations, including data integrity and security handling.

methods.name: createCode
methods.description: Creates a new Code entity after validation, handles data integrity issues, and returns the result.

methods.name: updateCode
methods.description: Updates an existing Code entity with new data, handles data integrity issues, and returns the result.

methods.name: deleteCode
methods.description: Deletes a Code entity if it is not system-defined, handles data integrity issues, and returns the result.

methods.name: retrieveCodeBy
methods.description: Retrieves a Code entity by ID or throws exception if not found.

methods.name: handleCodeDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity violations, throws specific exceptions for duplicate names or logs and maps other issues.
